item.title: Why Trump’s ‘Cash for Healthcare’ Idea Likely Wouldn’t Work in Practice
item.description: Last week, Trump proposed cutting out insurers and giving Americans cash to buy their own healthcare, claiming it would lower costs. Ali Diab, an economist and CEO of Collective Health, said the plan overlooks the real problem: concentrated payer power, opaque pricing and the financial risk people face without insurance.
